# Radial dial (`radial-dial`)

Knob for angles and amounts.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createRadialDial` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/radialDial.d.ts`): `.mh-dial`: a knob for an amount (volume, fan speed: a 270° arc filled to the value) or an angle (a direction,a full turn that wraps). The `__control` is a `role="slider"`: drag around it, or use the arrow keys, Page Up/Down,Home and End. Parts `__control`, `__svg`, `__track`, `__fill`, `__ticks`, `__thumb`, `__value`, `__label`.

```ts
export function createRadialDial(options: RadialDialOptions): RadialDialHandle;

export interface RadialDialOptions {
  /** Visible label under the dial. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  mode?: DialMode;
  /** Default 0. */
  min?: number;
  /** Default 100 (`amount`) or 360 (`angle`, where max equals min). */
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  /** Page Up / Page Down; default ten steps. */
  bigStep?: number;
  value?: number;
  /** Formats the value in the middle and the spoken `aria-valuetext` (e.g. `v => v + '°'`). */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Shows the value in the middle. Default true. */
  showValue?: boolean;
  /** Tick marks around the dial. */
  ticks?: number;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** While turning. */
  onInput?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
  /** When the dial is let go or moved by key. */
  onChange?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface RadialDialHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The `role="slider"` element that takes focus. */
  control: HTMLDivElement;
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createRadialDial } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const volume = createRadialDial({
  label: 'Volume',
  value: 35,
  ticks: 11,
  format: (v) => `${v}%`,
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `Kitchen speaker at ${value}%`),
});

document.body.append(volume.el, status);
```
